description: This file defines the AdoNetStreamOptions class, which encapsulates configuration options for ADO.NET streaming within Orleans. It includes properties such as connection string, timeout settings, attempt counts, and eviction parameters.

classes.name: AdoNetStreamOptions
classes.description: Represents configuration options for ADO.NET streaming, including connection details, timeout settings, and eviction policies.

methods.name: Getter and Setter methods for each property
methods.description: Standard property accessors for configuration parameters such as Invariant, ConnectionString, MaxAttempts, and various TimeSpan settings.
